owner: Claude lane (schemas-strict) — the exact conventions tools/belt/checks/* enforce; injected by the controller into inputData.output_conventions so the generator is graded only on rules it was told. Sol folds these into prompts/*.md at the next re-pin.

02.dossier_sections.envelope_scope: kind MUST match what you emit: if sections contains all nine ids (A,B,C,C2,D,E,E2,F,G) then kind=complete_dossier, assigned_section_ids lists all nine, chunk_index=1, chunk_total=1. kind=partial_chunk is allowed ONLY when sections contains exactly the assigned_section_ids and nothing else. Prefer complete_dossier for a single-call section.
02.dossier_sections.sections.merge_seq: merge_seq values are 1..N contiguous and unique across the chunks of this envelope (N = number of chunks in the envelope); never reuse a global counter.
02.dossier_sections.sections.learner_facing: sections A and C are learner_facing:true (their prose may be shown to learners); B, C2, D, E, E2, F, G are learner_facing:false.
02.dossier_sections.sections.char_count: char_count = number of Unicode code points of sections[].markdown exactly as emitted; the validator recomputes it; it must be below section_char_limit (max 12000).
02.dossier_sections.citations: every fact-bearing line (any line containing a number, threshold, distance, time, age, fee, penalty, or a rule) must cite a declared source anchor: either inline as [Axx] on that line, or as the lead line of a fact block in the form 'FACT_ID: <id> | anchor: Axx' followed by the block's lines and a trailer 'Source: [Axx -> <source_page>]'. A line with no supporting page carries '(verify)' plus an open verification_debt claim_id instead of a value. Sections F (VERIFY list) and G (DoD matrix) are bookkeeping and are not graded for per-line citations.
02.dossier_sections.source_anchors: every anchor id used in markdown is declared in sections[].source_anchors with its registered source_page code; anchors never map to two pages.
02.dossier_sections.exam_facts: exam_facts entries are {value, status, source_page}; status unknown REQUIRES value null and source_page null; status verified REQUIRES a non-null value and a registered source_page; never fill a placeholder, never guess an exam name, body, count, time or threshold; verified facts supplied in safe_run_config.exam_facts may be restated with their source_page.
02.dossier_sections.numerals: no numeral whose fact status is not verified, and no value listed in verification_debt[].withheld_values, may appear in learner_facing sections.
02.dossier_sections.high_yield_ranked: one contiguous ranked list per knowledge domain present in the chunk; each entry names item_refs that exist in the chunk's fact ids.
02.dossier_sections.verification_debt: typed per the 02 contract: blocker_kind, source_tier_required, owner_worker, ship_blocking, expires_by, claim_id, located_at (chunk_id:Lnn).
02.dossier_sections.no_reproduction: no handbook sentence, table, image or official question is copied; original wording; no learner text overlaps the handbook by more than 12 consecutive normalized words.
02.dossier_sections.lineage: lineage.input_manifest_sha256 = the system header value bindings.input_manifest_sha256 (also runtime_bindings.input_manifest_sha256 when present); lineage.candidate_lineage_id = the system header value task.candidate_lineage_id; lineage.source_registry_sha256 = runtime_bindings.source_registry_sha256; lineage.source_liveness_sha256 = runtime_bindings.source_liveness_sha256. Copy exactly; never null, never invented.
02.dossier_sections.expected_merged_sha256: you cannot compute SHA-256 of your own output: set merge.expected_merged_sha256 to null (or 64 zeros); the validator computes and records the merged hash. For partial_chunk envelopes the merged hash is not compared.
02.dossier_sections.depth: DEPTH: this is a research dossier, not a summary. Section C must carry EVERY rule, threshold, distance, time, exception and definition found in the selected handbook pages, one FACT_ID block per fact (expect 1-3 blocks per handbook page; a 12-page section yields well over 10 blocks and 6,000–9,500 code points). A thin overview fails 02.DEPTH_FLOOR regardless of structure. Section A states exam/issuer facts only with verified status; B audience; C2 confusables; D accuracy flags; E/E2 market and teardown as typed debt if not researched; F VERIFY list; G DoD matrix.
02.dossier_sections.section_A_citations: every exam/issuer fact line in section A cites an anchor: declare one anchor per verified source_page given in safe_run_config.exam_facts (e.g. the handbook page for the passing standard) in source_anchors and put [Axx] on the line.
02.dossier_sections.g_matrix_located_at: G matrix located_at must be the exact chunk_id:Lnn of the line where that item actually appears (count lines of that chunk's markdown from 1); e.g. if "Misconceptions:" is line 54 of chunk C, write C:L54. The validator resolves every located_at; a wrong line number fails G_MATRIX. Put misconceptions, mnemonics, glossary and dynamic-fact isolation as clearly labelled lines in C and point at them.
02.dossier_sections.assigned_dossier_parts: When inputData.assigned_dossier_parts is present (e.g. ["C"]), emit kind=partial_chunk with assigned_section_ids EXACTLY equal to that list and a sections array containing ONLY those section ids — no other sections, no stubs for the others. chunk_index and chunk_total are as given in inputData.chunk_plan (default 1/1). Put the full depth into those parts: every rule, threshold, exception and definition in the selected pages, one FACT_ID block per fact. The G matrix, VERIFY list and other parts arrive in later calls and are merged deterministically by role 16; do not reference them here.
02.dossier_sections.needs_dedicated_surface: needs_dedicated_surface: list every scored sub-skill in the selected pages that needs its own practice mode (e.g. sign recognition, right-of-way scenarios) with status declared and a one-line why; if you cannot determine it from the pages, set status unknown AND add a verification_debt entry with blocker_kind exam_policy_unclear, located_at a line in section C, owner_worker 02, ship_blocking false. Never leave status unknown without that debt.
02.dossier_sections.sections_char_budget: HARD CAP: each sections[].markdown must stay BELOW 12,000 Unicode code points (the validator treats >= 12,000 as truncated and FAILs). Target 6,000–9,500 for section C: one FACT_ID block per fact, each block 2–4 lines (statement, why it matters, source) — terse, no repetition, no preamble paragraphs. If the selected pages hold more facts than fit, keep every fact but shorten the explanations; never drop facts to save space and never pad.
02.dossier_sections.g_matrix_on_partial: When the chunk does not include section G (e.g. assigned_dossier_parts ["C"]), emit g_matrix as an EMPTY array []. The DoD matrix is produced only with part G.
02.dossier_sections.merge_order_across_parts: Within your envelope, merge_seq is 1..N by document order. The dossier-wide order is NOT yours to encode: the validator/compiler merge parts in canonical section order A,B,C,C2,D,E,E2,F,G, then by merge_seq inside each section. Never continue another part's numbering.
02.dossier_sections.high_yield_on_C2: C2 is a knowledge continuation of C: when you emit C2 alone, its chunks carry a domain label and high_yield_ranked covers that domain (chunk_id must be one of your C2 chunks).
02.dossier_sections.depth_floor_numbers: HARD MINIMUMS per chunk (inputData.depth_floor, graded by 02.DEPTH_FLOOR): section A markdown >= 400 code points; section C >= 2500 code points AND >= 10 FACT_ID blocks; every other section >= 200 code points. Count before you emit; pad with substance (more rules, exceptions, definitions from the pages), never filler.
02.dossier_sections.exam_facts_by_part: Only part A authors exam_facts (exam_name, issuing_body, edition, … with status verified when restating safe_run_config.exam_facts, else unknown). Every other part emits each exam_facts entry as {value:null, status:unknown, source_page:null} — not asserted — so the merge never sees two different authored values.
02.dossier_sections.dedicated_surface_by_part: needs_dedicated_surface is authored with part C (declared/none_required with items, or unknown backed by an exam_policy_unclear VerificationDebt located in C). Every other part emits {status: unknown, items: []} — not asserted here.
02.dossier_sections.g_matrix_located_at_format: g_matrix[].located_at is a chunk_id EXACTLY as it appears in sections[].chunk_id (e.g. "G.01", or a sibling part's chunk such as "C.01" when the box is evidenced there). An optional ":L<n>" line suffix is tolerated; nothing else (no headings, no page refs).
02.dossier_sections.lineage_hashes: lineage.source_registry_sha256 = runtime_bindings.source_registry_sha256 and lineage.input_manifest_sha256 = runtime_bindings.input_manifest_sha256 (copy both exactly, in EVERY part, even parts that cite nothing). Never leave them empty.
02.dossier_sections.lineage_to_copy: LINEAGE: copy inputData.lineage_to_copy.input_manifest_sha256 and .candidate_lineage_id VERBATIM into this output (03: lineage.input_manifest_sha256 + lineage.candidate_lineage_id; 04/05/06: top-level input_manifest_sha256 + candidate_lineage_id). The input_manifest_sha256 printed inside accepted_inputs (compiled dossier, KG, deck) is THEIR binding, never yours.
02.dossier_sections.id_namespace: ID NAMESPACE (multi-section handbook): FACT_ID values are prefixed with the section short code = first token of section_ids, e.g. "sec10-F01", "sec10-F02" (part C) and "sec10-R01" … (part C2); chunk ids stay "C.01", "C2.01" etc.; anchors stay "A01" …. Section 9 (already accepted) keeps its unprefixed ids.
02.dossier_sections.g_matrix_dispositions: g_matrix dispositions (enum ["completed","debt","non_applicable"]): a box whose content was authored in an ACCEPTED sibling part (high-yield list, misconceptions, mnemonics, glossary in C/C2; market pack in E/E2; verify list in F) is "completed" with located_at = that sibling chunk id (e.g. "C.01") — NOT "debt". Use "debt" ONLY with debt_ref = the claim_id of a VerificationDebt entry you emit in THIS envelope's verification_debt[] (never null). Use "non_applicable" with a note when the handbook section genuinely has no such content.
02.dossier_sections.fact_block_layout: FACT block layout (the compiler indexes it): line 1 "FACT_ID: <id> | anchor: Axx"; line 2 (immediately, NO blank line) = the fact statement as ONE complete sentence or short paragraph in spoken form, ending with the inline anchor token [Axx]; optional commentary lines after it must start with "Why it matters:" (they are NOT part of the fact); then "Source: [Axx -> page]"; then ONE blank line before the next FACT_ID. The statement line becomes the flashcard back verbatim — write it to be read aloud.
02.dossier_sections.statement_originality: Fact statements are PARAPHRASED in your own words: never more than 12 consecutive words identical to the handbook text (the statement becomes a flashcard back and a learner-facing sentence; verbatim handbook copy is a licensing and quality defect). Keep every number, term and condition exact; change the wording.
02.dossier_sections.one_page_per_fact: Each FACT block states ONE fact from ONE handbook page: the lead anchor ("| anchor: Axx") is the page of record and the statement cites that same [Axx]. If a rule spans two pages, split it into two FACT blocks, one per page. Never cite two different pages inside one fact statement.
02.dossier_sections.c2_fact_sentences: Part C2 FACT blocks follow the SAME layout as C: "FACT_ID: <id> | anchor: Axx" then a complete learner-readable rule sentence ending with [Axx] (a real statement about the rule, e.g. confusable pairs and their difference), then Source, then a blank line. KG hint metadata (group, prereq, difficulty, confusable ids) goes ONLY in a trailing "Why it matters:" line or in the envelope's structured fields — never inside the fact statement, never as the whole statement.
02.dossier_sections.market_signal_by_part: market_signal is authored ONLY in part E (disposition "present", chunk_ids = your E chunk ids, origin "sme"). In EVERY other part emit exactly {disposition: "scoped_out", chunk_ids: [], debt_refs: [], origin: "sme", origin_note: "market signal is authored in part E"}. Never "typed_debt" without debt_refs that name VerificationDebt claim_ids in THIS envelope.

03.combined_kg.node_identity: nodes[] = EXACTLY one node per id in inputData.node_ids_required (node.id = that id, node.fact_ids = [that id]). Ids in inputData.hint_ids_excluded are NOT nodes and must not appear anywhere in nodes/edges/learning_path/modules/confusables (they are C2 KG hints only). Never invent ids.
03.combined_kg.high_yield_set: nodes[].high_yield is true for EXACTLY the ids in accepted_inputs.high_yield_ids (all of them are in node_ids_required). No extras, none missing. Every high_yield node needs confusable_with[] with >=1 entry OR a non-empty no_confusable_reason.
03.combined_kg.confusables: confusable_with[] entries are {other_id, why, fact_ids}: other_id is another node id (never itself), why is non-empty, fact_ids includes at least one fact of THIS node and at least one fact of other_id (with node=fact identity that is [this.id, other_id]).
03.combined_kg.modules: modules[] = {module_id, node_ids[], official_weight, pedagogic_emphasis}. Every stable node appears in EXACTLY ONE module and node.module_id names it. Dynamic nodes (dynamic_nodes[]) never appear in nodes[], modules[] or learning_path.
03.combined_kg.learning_path: learning_path lists EVERY stable node id exactly once, in an order with zero prerequisite violations (if edge A->B type prerequisite then A before B). learning_path_rule = {dynamic_excluded: true, rule: "<short rule text>"}.
03.combined_kg.edges: edges[] = {from, to, type, confidence}: endpoints resolve to node ids, no self loops, confidence is a number in [0,1] (never null). The ontology block (department_pass.kg02) MUST declare every node type and edge type used, and the prerequisite edge type MUST be declared with directed: true and acyclic: true. The prerequisite subgraph must be acyclic. kg03.edges must be the SAME list as edges[] (identical records).
03.combined_kg.weights_honesty: official_weight = {value, status, source_page}. The Utah handbook publishes NO domain weights: use status "unknown" with value null and source_page null everywhere, OR status "authored" with a number and source_page null when you deliberately author emphasis. NEVER status unknown with a number, never status verified (there is no official blueprint page).
03.combined_kg.pedagogic_emphasis: Every node and module carries pedagogic_emphasis = {value: positive number, basis: non-empty text}. department_pass.kg04.domain_emphasis_check has ONE row per distinct node.domain: {domain, weight_status, computed_pct, blueprint_pct, drift_pp, within_tolerance, comparison_basis}. computed_pct = 100 * (sum of node emphasis in that domain) / (sum over all nodes), to 0.1. With weight_status unknown: blueprint_pct, drift_pp, within_tolerance are null and comparison_basis is NOT "official_verified" (use "authored_emphasis").
03.combined_kg.weight_closure: department_pass.kg02.weight_closure = {basis, sum, within_tolerance}. If module official_weight statuses are all unknown: basis "unknown", sum null, within_tolerance null. If all authored: basis "authored", module weights sum to 100 (±1), sum = that number, within_tolerance true.
03.combined_kg.kg05_assertions: department_pass.kg05.validation_assertions {prerequisite_violations, orphan_nodes, double_homes, dynamic_quarantined, path_check}: set every field to null (unclaimed) — the validator recomputes them; a wrong claimed number FAILS.
03.combined_kg.curriculum_hints: curriculum_unit_hints[]: EXACTLY one per module: {unit_id (unique), module_id, node_ids (same set as the module), user_cycle starting ["session","flashcards","module_hub", ...] with module_quiz only AFTER module_hub, hub_options including "module_quiz","flashcards","session", session_strategy, flashcard_strategy, quiz_strategy all non-empty}.
03.combined_kg.source_refs: source_refs.image_scout_pre_kg MUST be the literal "deferred:not_applicable_pilot". source_refs.learning_loop MUST equal accepted_inputs.learning_loop_ref exactly (copy the string).
03.combined_kg.probe_and_lineage: probe is the run slug (lowercase, digits, hyphens). lineage.input_manifest_sha256 and lineage.candidate_lineage_id are copied from runtime_bindings / safe_run_config exactly.
03.combined_kg.scope: Graph ONLY the accepted Section 9 dossier facts (Rules of the Road). Domains = the dossier domain labels. Keep it complete, not padded: every fact becomes a node; no nodes without a registered fact.
03.combined_kg.lineage_to_copy: LINEAGE: copy inputData.lineage_to_copy.input_manifest_sha256 and .candidate_lineage_id VERBATIM into this output (03: lineage.input_manifest_sha256 + lineage.candidate_lineage_id; 04/05/06: top-level input_manifest_sha256 + candidate_lineage_id). The input_manifest_sha256 printed inside accepted_inputs (compiled dossier, KG, deck) is THEIR binding, never yours.
03.combined_kg.kg01_block: department_pass.kg01 = {verdict: "PASS", gaps: [] (or typed gaps {type, severity: minor|major|blocking, located_at, detail} — a blocking gap forces verdict FAIL with ZERO nodes, so do not emit one unless the dossier is unusable), nodes_extracted: <exactly nodes.length>, dynamic_concepts: <EXACTLY the ids in dynamic_nodes[], same count, same strings>}. Every dynamic_nodes entry has why_dynamic.
03.combined_kg.id_namespace: ID NAMESPACE (multi-section handbook): prefix every id you mint with the section short code = the first token of section_ids (e.g. section "sec10-alcohol-drugs" → "sec10"). module_id = "sec10-m01", "sec10-m02" …; unit_id in curriculum_unit_hints = "sec10-u01" …; node ids stay = fact ids (already section-unique when the dossier used the section prefix) — if a fact id has no prefix, keep it as is.

04.cards.decks_mirror_kg: decks[] = ONE deck per accepted knowledge-graph module, in the SAME ORDER as accepted_inputs.knowledge_graph.modules; deck.module_id = that module_id; deck.module and deck.domain non-empty. Every KG node is either carded (a card with node_id = that node) or listed in merges[] (merged_node_ids >= 2, card_id of a real card, justification non-empty). card.module_id equals its deck module_id and the KG node module. card.is_dynamic is true ONLY for ids in knowledge_graph.dynamic_nodes.
04.cards.back_fidelity: card.back is BYTE-EQUAL to inputData.accepted_fact_statements[<fact_id>] — copy the string character for character (same words, same punctuation, no added period, no rewording, no spoken-form "fixing"). claims_fact_ids = [that fact id]. If a statement looks awkward, copy it anyway: the back IS the accepted wording. Never card a fact whose statement is missing from that map.
04.cards.spoken_form: front and memory_hook are spoken form: no symbols (%, &, /, #, °, $), no bare unit abbreviations (mph, ft, sec), no digit glued to a unit; write numbers as words. The back is exempt from your judgement — it must equal the accepted statement exactly.
04.cards.hooks: memory_hook = 1..6 words. hook_origin is "minted" when accepted_inputs.blueprint_mnemonics has no entry for the node; "sme-carried" only when the hook equals that mnemonic text; "sme-adapted" only when a mnemonic exists and you changed it.
04.cards.srs_policy: srs_policy = {base_tier_by_difficulty: {easy: "relaxed", medium: "standard", hard: "tight"}, high_yield_rule: "tighten_one_step", policy_kind: "product_policy", learning_loop_ref: null}. Every card: review_interval_tier = base tier of its difficulty, tightened one step (relaxed->standard->tight) when high_yield is true.
04.cards.exam_weight: deck.exam_weight = {value: null, status: "unknown", source_page: null} (Utah publishes no domain weights; never a number under unknown). deck.pedagogic_emphasis = {kind: "authored_product_policy", value: <number >= 0 or null>}.
04.cards.citations: card.source_ref = {ref: <source_ref string from the fact>, pdf_page: <integer from the fact>, printed_page: <string or null>, page_map_id: <the fact page_map_id>} — copy them from fact_registry.facts[<id>]. Every card cites a page; a card you cannot cite is not emitted (or goes to verification_debt {debt_id, card_id, kind: "missing_page_citation", note}, which blocks acceptance).
04.cards.learner_text_hygiene: front/back/hook/recap text never contains "(verify", "needs_review", flag-as, MOD- codes, bare module ids, "Q:"/"A:" labels, doubled articles ("the the"), or visual deixis ("this sign", "shown below", "in the picture"). No learner field may share more than 12 contiguous words with the handbook text EXCEPT the back, which equals the accepted fact wording by rule — keep fronts and hooks in your own words.
04.cards.ids_and_order: card_id unique across all decks; intro_order integers >= 0, unique within a deck; node_id is a KG node id; front and back non-empty. cluster_id AND cluster_role are BOTH null on every ordinary card. Only when you record a merge (merges[]) do the merged cards share a cluster_id with cluster_role "umbrella" (the merged card) / "atomic" (members) — never set one without the other.
04.cards.recaps: recaps[] = exactly ONE per deck: {module_id, recap_hooks: [{text, fact_ids}]} where every fact_id appears on a card of that deck; recap text obeys the same hygiene.
04.cards.binding: probe = run slug; input_manifest_sha256 and candidate_lineage_id copied from runtime_bindings exactly; source_refs.knowledge_graph = the accepted KG ref path; source_refs.image_scout_post_kg = literal "deferred:not_applicable_pilot"; media_disposition_ref = {path, sha256} copied from runtime_bindings (pilot_overlay/media_disposition). verification_debt: [] when nothing is owed.
04.cards.scope: Card every accepted fact of the compiled Section 9 dossier (39 facts -> ~39 cards unless a justified merge). Difficulty easy|medium|hard is your authored judgement; high_yield mirrors the KG node flag.
04.cards.lineage_to_copy: LINEAGE: copy inputData.lineage_to_copy.input_manifest_sha256 and .candidate_lineage_id VERBATIM into this output (03: lineage.input_manifest_sha256 + lineage.candidate_lineage_id; 04/05/06: top-level input_manifest_sha256 + candidate_lineage_id). The input_manifest_sha256 printed inside accepted_inputs (compiled dossier, KG, deck) is THEIR binding, never yours.
04.cards.id_namespace: ID NAMESPACE (multi-section handbook): prefix every id you mint with the section short code = the first token of section_ids (e.g. section "sec10-alcohol-drugs" → "sec10"). card_id = "sec10-card-<fact_id>"; deck.module_id = the KG module id verbatim (already prefixed).

06.exam_bank.lineage_to_copy: LINEAGE: copy inputData.lineage_to_copy.input_manifest_sha256 and .candidate_lineage_id VERBATIM into this output (03: lineage.input_manifest_sha256 + lineage.candidate_lineage_id; 04/05/06: top-level input_manifest_sha256 + candidate_lineage_id). The input_manifest_sha256 printed inside accepted_inputs (compiled dossier, KG, deck) is THEIR binding, never yours.
06.exam_bank.item_binding: Every item: item_id unique; objective_id, node_id (a KG node id), module_id (its KG module), domain, stem non-empty; fact_ids >= 1 and every id exists in fact_registry; source_ref = {ref, pdf_page (integer >= 1), printed_page} copied from the fact. No item without a page (page_debt stays [] — an item you cannot page-cite is not written).
06.exam_bank.options: options = EXACTLY FOUR entries with keys "A","B","C","D" in that order — never a fifth option, never a repeated key, never two options with the same text; each option has a non-empty rationale. correct_key is one of A/B/C/D. Count your options before emitting each item. distractor_source = exactly 3 non-empty strings (one per wrong option; label synthesized near-misses as "synthesized near-miss: …").
06.exam_bank.numerals_rule: The fact registry facts are status "authored" (not "verified"), and the numeral check only accepts digits anchored in VERIFIED facts. Therefore: in stems, the correct option, correct_rationale and option rationales write EVERY number as words ("two seconds", "one hundred feet", "fifteen miles per hour"); digits may appear only inside distractor option TEXTS. Quiz titles and form titles carry no digits at all.
06.exam_bank.practice_forms: practice_forms >= 2 (a retake is a real retest), e.g. form_id "form-a"/"form-b". title MUST contain the word "practice" and NO digits (e.g. "Rules of the Road Practice Test A"). declared_count == item_ids.length (>= 1), no repeated item id within a form. Pairwise item overlap between forms <= 20% (or both forms carry a learner-visible overlap_note). No is_derived item in any form (derived items live only in module quizzes).
06.exam_bank.official_mirror: official_mirror per form: n_questions = {value: 50, status: "verified", source_page: <the registered handbook page from safe_run_config.exam_facts>} and passing = {value: 80, status: "verified", source_page: <that page>} ONLY when safe_run_config.exam_facts shows those exact verified values — else {value: null, status: "unknown", source_page: null}. time = {value: null, status: "unknown", source_page: null} (not published). passing_unit "percent_correct" when passing is verified, else "unknown". official_mirror.status = "verified" only if n_questions AND passing are verified AND declared_count equals n_questions.value; otherwise the literal "NOT_APPLICABLE_PRACTICE_ONLY". A practice form of 25 items therefore has official_mirror.status "NOT_APPLICABLE_PRACTICE_ONLY" even though the exam facts are verified.
06.exam_bank.scoring_policy: scoring_policy = {kind: "product_policy", learning_loop_ref: <accepted_inputs.learning_loop_ref, copied exactly>} on every form. Never an official passing claim in learner text.
06.exam_bank.module_quizzes: module_quizzes = EXACTLY one per KG module (accepted_inputs.module_ids): {quiz_id, module_id, domain, title (no digits), item_ids non-empty, all items from that module}.
06.exam_bank.banned_claims: Learner strings never say actual/real/leaked/official question(s), never predict a pass, never say "full-length" or "full test" (time is unverified). Everything is practice.
06.exam_bank.duplicates: No two items with the same normalized stem AND same correct answer; no two items with identical correct option + distractor set + rationale (clones).
06.exam_bank.honesty_counters: needs_review_count = 0 and no item has needs_review true; self_flagged_distractors = [] and no item has self_flagged true; page_debt = []. If you are unsure of an item, drop it rather than flag it.
06.exam_bank.scope: Bank the compiled Section 9 facts: aim for 1–2 items per fact (~50–70 items), each stem a scenario or recall question in your own words (never a handbook sentence verbatim), 3 plausible near-miss distractors drawn from confusable rules.
06.exam_bank.rationale_names_answer: correct_rationale MUST begin with the literal phrase "Option <KEY> is correct: " using the correct_key letter (e.g. "Option B is correct: the overhead signal decides…"). It never affirms another option. Each distractor rationale says why THAT option is wrong and never calls another option correct.
06.exam_bank.id_namespace: ID NAMESPACE (multi-section handbook): prefix every id you mint with the section short code = the first token of section_ids (e.g. section "sec10-alcohol-drugs" → "sec10"). item_id = "sec10-itm-01" …, form_id = "sec10-form-a"/"sec10-form-b", quiz_id = "sec10-quiz-<module_id>"; module_id/objective_id come from the KG verbatim.

05.sessions.lineage_to_copy: LINEAGE: copy inputData.lineage_to_copy.input_manifest_sha256 and .candidate_lineage_id VERBATIM into this output (03: lineage.input_manifest_sha256 + lineage.candidate_lineage_id; 04/05/06: top-level input_manifest_sha256 + candidate_lineage_id). The input_manifest_sha256 printed inside accepted_inputs (compiled dossier, KG, deck) is THEIR binding, never yours. Also source_registry_sha256 = runtime_bindings.source_registry_sha256.
05.sessions.units: units[] = one teaching unit per KG module (unit_id unique, module_id = the KG module, objective_ids >= 1 unique). Every learner span is an object {text, fact_ids} with fact_ids >= 1, unique, and EVERY id present in fact_registry (status authored is fine; never an id that is not in the registry).
05.sessions.decompression_fields: Each unit populates ALL of: why_how[] (>= 1 span), worked_example {scenario, reasoning, result}, misconception {claim, correction}, memory_support, self_check {prompt, answer, rationale}. misconception.claim text must contain an explicit wrong-alternative label word: "misconception", "myth", "common mistake", "many people think", "wrong", "not true" or "trap".
05.sessions.self_check: self_check.prompt.fact_ids MUST reuse fact ids that appear in the SAME unit's why_how[], worked_example or misconception spans (pick one of those ids; never a fact taught only on a slide). self_check.answer shares >= 1 fact id with the prompt. One slide of kind "self_check" carries the prompt's fact ids (in its title, lines or narration). The prompt is never a verbatim exam-bank stem.
05.sessions.slides: slides[] per unit: EXACTLY 6, 7 or 8 slides (count them; 5 or 9 fails). slides[0].kind MUST be "opening" and the LAST element of slides[] MUST be kind "close" — nothing after it (no concept, no self_check after the close). In between: at least one "trap" or "bridge" slide and at least one "self_check" slide; the rest "concept". Every slide: title <= 6 words, lines = 1..4 spans of <= 15 words each (concept slides 2..4 lines), slide_id unique, narration {text, fact_ids} and estimated_narration_seconds a number in 30..60 (text-cadence estimate: ~2.5 words per second).
05.sessions.variety: Across >= 2 units the slide counts must NOT all be equal (e.g. 7, 6, 8 — never 7, 7, 7).
05.sessions.narration_depth: EVERY slide narration.text is 520–760 characters (about 90–130 spoken words; roughly 4–6 sentences) — count characters before emitting; the validator requires a per-unit AVERAGE of at least 400 and anything shorter fails. Narration is plain spoken prose with NO stage directions and NO words from this list anywhere: pause, pausing, beat, silence, wait a few seconds, ellipsis "...". The self_check slide narration opens with "Here is a quick check:" (never "Pause and test yourself"). Narration never asks the learner to speak or say anything aloud.
05.sessions.learner_text_hygiene: No span contains "(verify", needs_review, flag-as, QA scaffold, doubled articles, internal ids (fact ids, unit/slide/module ids, objective ids), hashes, or the words fact_ids/source_ref/node_id/slide_id/schema_version. Titles make no countable promise ("Top 5", "All 10 rules", "7 signs").
05.sessions.scope: Teach the compiled Section 9 facts through the KG modules (accepted_inputs.knowledge_graph). Use the accepted card hooks (accepted_inputs.carddeck, when present) as memory_support where they fit.
05.sessions.id_namespace: ID NAMESPACE (multi-section handbook): prefix every id you mint with the section short code = the first token of section_ids (e.g. section "sec10-alcohol-drugs" → "sec10"). unit_id = "sec10-u01" …, slide_id = "sec10-u01-s01" …; module_id from the KG verbatim.

05.card_scripts.lineage_to_copy: LINEAGE: copy inputData.lineage_to_copy.input_manifest_sha256 and .candidate_lineage_id VERBATIM into this output (03: lineage.input_manifest_sha256 + lineage.candidate_lineage_id; 04/05/06: top-level input_manifest_sha256 + candidate_lineage_id). The input_manifest_sha256 printed inside accepted_inputs (compiled dossier, KG, deck) is THEIR binding, never yours.
05.card_scripts.coverage: audio_scripts[] = exactly ONE card script per accepted card in accepted_inputs.carddeck (is_recap false, card_id = that card, module_id = its deck) PLUS exactly ONE recap script per deck (is_recap true, module_id = the deck module_id). No scripts for cards that are not in the accepted deck. script_id unique.
05.card_scripts.segments: Card script segments object has EXACTLY these keys in THIS order: question, think_ref, recall_pause_ms, answer, teaching. question = {lead_in, text} where text == the accepted card front; think_ref == think_cue.cue_id (one shared cue for the whole artifact, speakable, no direction, never asks the learner to speak); recall_pause_ms == 3000 (silent data); answer = {lead_in, text} where text is BYTE-EQUAL to the accepted card back (accepted_inputs.carddeck card.back — copy it exactly) and equals must_match_card_back; teaching = {text} containing must_match_memory_hook verbatim, where must_match_memory_hook equals the accepted card memory_hook.
05.card_scripts.recap_scripts: Recap script: segments null, must_match_card_back null, must_match_memory_hook null, recap = {narration_text, hooks_spoken: [every recap hook text of that deck, verbatim]}.
05.card_scripts.voice_fields: voice "narrated" on every script, with tone, pacing, repeat_count (integer >= 1) and pause_after_ms (integer >= 0) all set. visual_route is NOT "tap_ui" for narrated scripts. source_ref = the card source_ref copied exactly ({ref, pdf_page, printed_page, page_map_id}).
05.card_scripts.spoken_hygiene: Narrated text never contains stage directions ("[pause]", "(beat)", timed silences, ellipses), never asks the learner to speak, never presents practice as official/actual/real, never leaks "(verify"/scaffold text, never refers to a visual ("this sign", "shown here"). pronunciation hints only for proper nouns, as {term, say} with the same number of tokens.
05.card_scripts.audio_render: audio_render MUST be the literal "deferred:not_applicable_pilot" and media_disposition_ref = {path, sha256} copied from runtime_bindings (pilot media disposition). No audio is rendered in this pilot; these are text scripts.
05.card_scripts.scope: Script every accepted card; keep lead_ins short and warm; the teaching segment explains the rule in two or three spoken sentences and ends with the hook.
05.card_scripts.id_namespace: ID NAMESPACE (multi-section handbook): prefix every id you mint with the section short code = the first token of section_ids (e.g. section "sec10-alcohol-drugs" → "sec10"). script_id = "script.<card_id>" (card ids are already prefixed); think_cue.cue_id = "sec10-think".
05.card_scripts.think_cue: think_cue = {cue_id: "<sec>-think", text: "Think about your answer."} — a short speakable prompt; never the words pause, beat, wait, seconds, silence, or an ellipsis, and never asking the learner to speak aloud. Every card script's segments.think_ref equals think_cue.cue_id.
